name: 2026 Large Size Mah Jongg Cards, Four-Pack
whyWeLikeIt: The League publishes the official hand card every year, and large print means nobody at the table squints. A four-pack covers a full game with a spare.
whoItsFor: Hosts of an American mahjong night, and anyone learning the game who wants the official card rather than a look-alike.
limitations: A new card is issued each year, so this one is for 2026 play. It is for American mahjong only and does not include tiles or a set.
descriptionOriginal: Four large-print copies of the National Mah Jongg League's official 2026 hand card for American mahjong.
